payload.body: PARTIAL (PR #8): native frick verify (drift check via frick-codegen) + frick schema export landed. REMAINING: make frick schema generate WRITE the tracked artifacts via frick-codegen and retire pnpm schema:generate as the canonical generator (frick schema generate is currently in-process / does not write the artifact paths). That write-path swap is the residual for this ticket.
